outcome: successful vaginal delivery of both twins
cohort: The study included 370 twin pregnancies delivered after 32 weeks of gestation at a single hospital between April 2012 and March 2022, excluding monoamniotic monochorionic twins.
finding: Multiparous women, regardless of maternal age, and primiparous women aged <= 29 years are independently associated with a high probability of successful vaginal twin delivery.
mod_finding: Multiparous women and primiparous women aged <= 29 years show a higher probability of successful vaginal twin delivery.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight of each twin was at least 1500g for consideration of vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Twin pregnancies delivered after 32 weeks of gestation were included.
